title: Delivery Projection Basis
description: The class of method a seller used to project a package's end-of-flight delivery. Names the method class, not its parameters: the trailing window length, model name, or seasonality inputs belong in the projection's `ext`. Values MAY be added in later minor releases; a client on an older schema version SHOULD treat a value it does not recognize like `seller_defined`.

enumDescriptions.trailing_daily_avg: Extrapolates the package's recent daily delivery rate across the remaining flight.
enumDescriptions.trailing_hourly_avg: Extrapolates the package's recent hourly delivery rate across the remaining flight, using hour-of-day data a daily breakdown does not expose.
enumDescriptions.platform_model: Produced by the seller platform's predictive model (for example seasonality, inventory availability, or auction-pressure modeling) rather than a straight-line extrapolation.
enumDescriptions.seller_defined: A method that fits none of the other values. The seller describes it in the projection's `ext`; buyers cannot compare it across sellers.
